authority: Central Provident Fund Act 1953 s.7 and the First Schedule, as varied by the CPF (Contribution Rate) Notification. authority: Central Provident Fund Act 1953 s.13B and the Eurasian Community Fund contribution schedule published by the CPF Board — a monthly employee-borne contribution by wage band, deducted and remitted with CPF, payable by Eurasian Singapore Citizens and Permanent Residents. Contribution is voluntary in the sense that an employee may opt out by written application to the fund; the schedule below is the default the employer must deduct. Base: allowances are wages (CPF Act 1953 s.2 'wages': all remuneration in money including allowances; the SDL Order and the self-help-group schedules read total wages), so catalog('ALLOWANCE') is in every base; a reimbursement row must be excluded by name.

name: Skills Development Levy
authority: Skills Development Levy Act 1979 s.3 with the Skills Development Levy Order — 0.25% of the first SGD 4,500 of monthly remuneration, a minimum of SGD 2 for an employee earning less than SGD 800 a month and a maximum of SGD 11.25 for one earning more than SGD 4,500.
